[name]
Columbus, OH | [email] | [phone] | [url]

EDUCATION
The Ohio State University — Columbus, OH
M.S. in Materials Science and Engineering, August 2026 | GPA 3.54
Thesis: "Microstructural evolution of additively manufactured Inconel 718 under post-build heat treatment" (defended June 2026)
Thesis committee of three faculty members; thesis supported by a departmental research assistantship for the final year

The Ohio State University — Columbus, OH
B.S. in Materials Science and Engineering, May 2024 | GPA 3.41
Senior capstone: corrosion testing of coated fasteners for an agricultural equipment sponsor

RESEARCH EXPERIENCE
Graduate Research Assistant, Advanced Alloys Laboratory, The Ohio State University
August 2025 – August 2026
- Prepared, sectioned and polished about 120 laser-powder-bed-fusion Inconel 718 specimens across four heat-treatment schedules
- Collected SEM and EBSD data on grain size, texture and precipitate distribution; performed Vickers microhardness mapping on every specimen set
- Analyzed data in MATLAB and OIM Analysis; found a hardness plateau after 8 hours of aging that informed the lab's follow-on study
- Maintained the laboratory's furnace calibration log and trained two undergraduate students on sample preparation
- Manuscript based on the thesis in preparation for submission to a materials journal (first author, with adviser)

Undergraduate Research Assistant, Advanced Alloys Laboratory
January 2024 – May 2024
- Assisted graduate students with tensile testing and fractography of welded steel coupons
- Organized the lab's specimen inventory in a shared spreadsheet

TEACHING EXPERIENCE
Graduate Teaching Assistant, The Ohio State University, Department of Materials Science and Engineering
August 2024 – May 2026 (four semesters)
- Led laboratory sections for Introduction to Materials Science (about 48 students per semester) and Mechanical Behavior of Materials (about 30 students)
- Graded lab reports and problem sets; held weekly office hours
- Prepared demonstration specimens and maintained the teaching metallography laboratory

SKILLS
Characterization: SEM, EBSD, optical microscopy, XRD (basic), Vickers and Rockwell hardness testing, tensile testing (Instron), DSC
Processing: heat treatment, metallographic sample preparation, basic machining
Software: MATLAB, OIM Analysis, ImageJ, Thermo-Calc (introductory), Microsoft Office, LaTeX

PRESENTATIONS
- Departmental graduate research symposium, The Ohio State University, April 2026 (poster)
- Capstone design showcase, College of Engineering, April 2024 (team presentation)

MEMBERSHIPS AND ACTIVITIES
- Student member, TMS (The Minerals, Metals and Materials Society), 2024 – Present
- Student member, ASM International, Columbus chapter, 2023 – Present
- Volunteer, engineering outreach day for middle-school students, 2024 and 2025
